description.value:
Tacticians treat warfare as a science, breaking down engagements into angles, timing, and lines of fire the way other scholars parse a text. Where a duelist relies on instinct, the Tactician relies on preparation, turning cold study of strategy into decisive advantage before a shot is ever fired.

On the field, this discipline becomes leadership in action. A Tactician reads the flow of a fight and calls the exact strike that breaks it, coordinating allies into a single, devastating instrument aimed at whichever foe matters most.
